review_locator: PMCID:PMC7355470, Selectins review; PMCID:PMC3680630, E-selectin ligands as mechanosensitive receptors on neutrophils
primary_title: Post-translational modifications of recombinant P-selectin glycoprotein ligand-1 required for binding to P- and E-selectin; Isolated P-selectin glycoprotein ligand-1 dynamic adhesion to P- and E-selectin; P-selectin glycoprotein ligand-1 supports rolling on E- and P-selectin in vivo
decision_basis: The reviews identify PSGL1 as an E-selectin ligand and cite primary glycoform, isolated-ligand flow, and in-vivo microsphere studies showing E-selectin-dependent PSGL1 binding and slow rolling.
limitations_preserved: Preserve PSGL1 core-2 sialylated/fucosylated O-glycans, E-selectin ligand heterogeneity, and shear-flow/slow-rolling context; no intracellular PSGL1 relay or SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC7355470, Selectins review; PMID:10412562, Structure and function of the selectin ligand PSGL-1 review
primary_title: L-selectin binds to P-selectin glycoprotein ligand-1 on leukocytes; Molecular basis of leukocyte rolling on PSGL-1. Predominant role of core-2 O-glycans and of tyrosine sulfate residue 51
decision_basis: The reviews identify PSGL1 as a leukocyte ligand for L-selectin and cite primary blocking, glycoform, and mutation studies showing direct Ca2+-dependent L-selectin binding and PSGL1-dependent leukocyte rolling.
limitations_preserved: Preserve PSGL1 glycosylation, Tyr-51 sulfation, Ca2+ dependence, and leukocyte-on-leukocyte/shear-flow geometry; lower-affinity/shared selectin context and no intracellular PSGL1 relay or SCI inference.
